$comment: Combat v1 (spec pass S2 draft, 2026-11-07; docs/design/spec-s2-armies.md sections 2.2, 5, 6.2, 10). DRAFT: new file for data/rules. Integers only: mm, mm/s, mm/s2, ticks at 20 per second, permille, centi-degrees (cd), health points. Per-type melee values live in unit-types.json. Hits and damage use the seeded stream (combat, soldier, tick). order: open order multiplies file and rank spacing (D1, flag on, close by default). volley: hits = shooters * hitPermille(range) * orderFactor / 1e6, remainder rolled; hits land on target soldiers within impactRadiusMm of the aim point (centroid + velocity * flight time). charge: cavalry rules; a rider charges while at least chargingMinMmPerS; deep mud or water stops him dead (D7). regimentTargeting is the working default until the regiment AI (M7). smallRegimentsBlockCasts false: regiments under smallRegimentSoldiers don't block casts (D15).

regimentTargeting.$comment: Working default until M7: attackers march to the defender zone and turn on any enemy within attackerEngageMm; defenders hold and engage within defenderEngageMm; ranged stop to shoot when a target is in range and fall back rangedFallbackMm once per rangedFallbackCooldownTicks when enemy melee is within rangedFallbackTriggerMm.
